## Checklist

- [ ] Tests relevant to the change were run, or the reason they were not run is stated.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] `julia --project=docs docs/make.jl` was run for documentation changes.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the repository's MIT license.
- [ ] New or changed material models include references, implementation provenance, permission/license information for code-level references, and acknowledgements.
